newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue to weaken.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices continue to weaken.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly lower on Monday although some dealers detected signs the market may be beginning to bottom out after recent weakness.
"Too much good pasture in Texas and Oklahoma is making for real lousy feed use," one dealer said.
There was a trade in Kansas City reported at $64.00 per ton, representing a drop of around $14.00 since the end of last month.
Some dealers said the market may not fall much further, although any significant recovery this month appeared unlikely.
"June is historically the lowest price month. In July and August pastures begin to dry out and we get better usage," one dealer said.
